translations.zh: 是歲，勝諸子在東者，皆為齊神武所害。
translations.literal: That year, all of Sheng's sons who were in the east were killed by Qi Shenwu.
translations.idiomatic: That year, all of He Basheng's sons who were in the east were killed by Gao Huan (Qi Shenwu).

translations.literal: Sheng was filled with resentment and indignation and developed a chest disorder from agitation.
translations.idiomatic: He Basheng was filled with resentment and indignation and developed a chest disorder from agitation.

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Datong, he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Datong (544), he died in office.

translations.zh: 臨終，手書與太祖曰：「勝萬里杖策，歸身闕庭，冀望與公掃除逋寇。
translations.literal: At the end of his life he wrote by hand to the Grand Progenitor: "Sheng traveled ten thousand li with staff in hand, returning to submit at the imperial court, hoping together with you to sweep away the fugitive enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of his life he wrote by hand to Yuwen Tai: "Basheng traveled ten thousand li with staff in hand, returning to submit at the imperial court, hoping together with you to sweep away the fugitive enemy.

translations.literal: Unluckily I have perished; my slight ambition was not fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Unluckily I have perished; my slight ambition was not fulfilled.

translations.zh: 願公內先協和，順時而動。
translations.literal: I wish you would first achieve internal harmony and move according to the times.
translations.idiomatic: I wish you would first achieve internal harmony and move according to the times.

translations.zh: 若死而有知，猶望魂飛賊庭，以報恩遇耳。」
translations.literal: If in death there is consciousness, I still hope my spirit may fly to the enemy's court to repay your kindness and favor."
translations.idiomatic: If in death there is consciousness, I still hope my spirit may fly to the enemy's court to repay your kindness and favor."

translations.literal: The Grand Progenitor read the letter and wept for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai read the letter and wept for a long time.
